title_short: Dr. Verna Price · Entire School Year
headline: One new pair of shoes changes a child’s whole school year. She brought 120 kids to get them.
story: Dr. Verna Cornelia Price leads the Power of People Leadership Institute. She opens with the big idea: a new pair of shoes transforms a child’s entire school year. It gives them position and credibility at school.

Then the turn: she didn't grow up with new shoes. She was happy to have shoes on, period. Today she brought 120 young people, and Soles4Souls came alongside her group to do something wonderful. They left with big smiles. Warm and proud.
